subject: Re: Kickoff: extreme-memorization diagnostics track (Feb-May)
body:
Dmitri — resourcing picture from my side.

Staffing: Amara 50%, Saoirse 40%, Rafael 60%, Bilal 30% through April. Compute is modest — the sweeps are MLP/convnet scale, so titan-a100 best-effort covers us; I'm asking for ~64 A100s peak during the stddev sweep (we vary the w_1 custom_init stddev from 1e-3 upward, per the paper's setup).

Two constraints. First, storage: the shuffled_labels runs double our checkpoint volume, so I've requested 40TB scratch. Second, sequencing: the Corpus v2 migration freeze lands 2026-07-10, so all of our tfrecord re-ingestion for cifar10/cifar100/svhn has to be finished well before that freeze — Jun Varga's team confirmed the date. Plan assumes no new asks after the Q3 OKR lock.

Ivo
